keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Jaydee Canvot, Crystal Palace. Brighton and Hove Albion 1, Crystal Palace 0.

Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Crystal Palace 0. Diego Gómez (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from more than 35 yards to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Olivier Boscagli following a fast break.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 3, Crystal Palace 0. Yasin Ayari (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Charalampos Kostoulas.
Pascal Groß (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Dwight McNeil replaces Quinten Timber.

Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 4, Crystal Palace 0. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.

Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jefferson Lerma replaces Honest Ahanor.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jean-Philippe Mateta replaces Jørgen Strand Larsen.

article.headline: Five-goal Brighton run rampant over rivals Crystal Palace
article.description: Diego Gómez sensationally scored from the halfway line as Brighton struck three goals in the opening 10 minutes en route to thrashing bitter rivals Crystal Palace 5-0.
